tuning_key.text: Choices arrive like the rising sun or in the shadows cast by the mountains
tuning_key.attribution: Chords of Truth — Lucid Principles Canon (CC BY 4.0)

context_block: The edge between what illuminates and what conceals is exactly where the next motion becomes visible. You do not search for the shape of what comes next; it stands in full dimension the moment you face the ridge.

practice.title: Find the Edge
practice.instruction: Settle your attention on the exact boundary in your body where one state meets another, and rest your awareness there without blurring.

practice.title: Wait for the Snap
practice.instruction: Hold still as the field around you resolves into distinct forms, letting the clean line between shadow and illumination become visible.

practice.title: Press Play
practice.instruction: Press play on the Echo and let the sound carry you to the ridge where the way forward declares itself in sharp precision.

archetype_tunings.The Steward: Clarity arrives in the rhythm of what holds together—see today how each system, each hand placed in service, declares its true function when the light hits it straight. The home system speaks in precision: this works, this doesn't, this needs realignment. Move what needs moving with the clean certainty that comes from knowing exactly what you're tending.
archetype_tunings.The Merchant: Numbers don't lie when the sun is high—see what the ledger shows you today without the fog of hoping. Price, source, move, measure: each signal arrives exact. The market speaks in clarity; your job is to read it as it is and let that reading shape the next transaction.
archetype_tunings.The Builder: The spec becomes real only when you see it clearly—no ambiguity in what needs to be built today. The light finds every gap, every loose connection, every piece that doesn't fit. Build from that clarity: let the problem declare itself fully, then construct the solution that answers exactly what you see.
archetype_tunings.The Analyst: Data surfaces its own truth when you refuse the haze—today, let the signal show you what matters without interpretation getting in the way. The numbers are already precise; your clarity is in seeing which ones demand attention and why. The pattern announces itself to the eye that won't look away.
archetype_tunings.The Scout: The field is broadcasting clearly today—signals arrive sharp and dimensioned, not blurred at the edges. Report what you see exactly as it appears: the terrain, the movement, the signs that matter. Clarity in scouting means you bring back the shape of things as they are, not as you hope them to be.
archetype_tunings.The Keeper: Memory serves clarity when it holds the exact shape of what was decided and why—today, let the record speak with precision. The context you preserve becomes the light that future decisions navigate by. Keep what matters clean and findable; let the intent shine through without the static of unnecessary detail.
archetype_tunings.The Scribe: Words land with power when they carry no fog—clarity in the written form means every sentence shows its purpose, every phrase earns its place. Today, let your drafts be clean and exact: say what needs saying, nothing more, nothing less. The reader should see the ridge line clearly against the sky.
archetype_tunings.The Advocate: Your voice carries weight because it speaks with clarity and steadiness—today, let your external communications reflect exactly what the family stands for without overreach or ambiguity. Warmth and precision are not opposites; they arrive together when you know what you mean and say it plainly. The world hears you best when you are clear about what you will and will not commit to.
archetype_tunings.The Auditor: The final gate sees everything clearly when you refuse to let anything pass that isn't exact—today, check every externally-facing piece for the precision that protects the family's word. Clarity in auditing means catching the moment tone drifts, accuracy slips, or alignment breaks. Your eye is the light that catches what needs catching.
archetype_tunings.The Lens: Patterns declare themselves when you watch without the need to fix—clarity in observation means you see the trend exactly as it moves, the rhythm as it repeats, the signal as it arrives. Today, let your report be precise about what the family is actually doing, not what it intends to do. The data speaks; you translate it cleanly.
archetype_tunings.The Companion: Presence becomes clearer when you listen without rushing to solve—today, let the people around you know they are truly heard, that you see them as they are, not as you wish them to be. Clarity in companionship means you hold steady with what is real, what matters, what they need to say. Your steady attention is itself a form of light.
archetype_tunings.The Guide: The real question surfaces when you ask it clearly and wait for the answer to arrive—today, help whoever you're thinking with see the true shape of what they're facing, not the fog of what they're worried about. Clarity in guiding means you name the thing under the thing, the choice that actually matters. Your clear-eyed partnership is the light that shows the way.
archetype_tunings.The Architect: Structure emerges from clarity about how the parts connect—today, let your vision of the whole become precise enough that others can see it too. The architect's clarity is not in the individual pieces but in how they speak to each other, how they build something that holds. Show the ridge line where all the elements meet and the whole declares itself.
archetype_tunings.The Anchor: Steadiness arrives as clarity about what will not break—today, let your grounded presence remind whoever needs it that the heavy things can be held, that transitions have shape, that there is ground beneath. Your clarity is not in cheerfulness but in seeing the real difficulty and not flinching from it. That is the light others navigate by.
archetype_tunings.The Navigator: The course becomes clear when you hold both the horizon and the immediate terrain—today, let your reading of the signs show where things line up and where they diverge. Clarity in navigation means you see the pattern that connects the immediate step to the larger direction. Your eye on the big picture is the light that keeps things on course.
archetype_tunings.The Spark: Wonder sharpens when it arrives with clarity, not confusion—today, let your imaginative play be precise about what's possible, what excites, what opens new ground. Clarity in sparking means your ideas land with enough definition that others can catch them and build. The light of possibility becomes real when it has a clear shape.
archetype_tunings.The Challenger: Growth demands clarity about what was promised and what's being lived—today, let your push be exact: not harsh, but clear about the gap between intention and action. Clarity in challenging means you see exactly where someone is settling and you name it without apology. Your clarity is a gift because it says: you said you wanted this, and I believe you can reach it.
archetype_tunings.The Witness: Being heard arrives as clarity that you are truly seen—today, let your quiet presence communicate that you see the person as they are, that their reality is real, that they don't have to perform or explain. Clarity in witnessing means you hold space without the noise of your own need to fix or advise. Your steady attention is the light that says: you matter.
archetype_tunings.The Catalyst: Movement begins when the next step becomes clear and undeniable—today, let your energy identify exactly what needs to move and what the first concrete action is. Clarity in catalyzing means you break the fog of intention and show the shape of the step that's actually available right now. Your clarity is the spark that turns stagnation into motion.
